rebar_hosts.mixed_note: Columns and beams take bars and stirrups; walls, slabs and foundations take mesh. Select one group to add rebar.
rebar_hosts.why.mixed: The selection mixes columns or beams with walls, slabs or foundations. Select one group.
rebar_hosts.why.area_linear: Mesh goes into walls, slabs and foundations, not columns or beams.
rebar_hosts.why.bars_plate: Longitudinal bars and stirrups go into columns and beams, not walls, slabs or foundations.
rebar_hosts.why.no_common_face: The selected hosts have no cover face in common. Select hosts of one kind.
